sections.content: Use the pretérito indefinido to present an experience as a completed event. It gives a memory its turning point: something happened once, was witnessed, or was tried for the first time.

items.spanish: Por primera vez, me atreví a intervenir en el debate que se celebró en el auditorio.
items.english: For the first time, I dared to intervene in the debate held in the auditorium.

items.spanish: Presencié una ceremonia intensa y una actuación que terminó con un aplauso largo.
items.english: I witnessed an intense ceremony and a performance that ended with long applause.

items.spanish: Aunque estaba nervioso, defendí a mi amiga porque quería mencionar una injusticia.
items.english: Although I was nervous, I defended my friend because I wanted to mention an injustice.

items.spanish: Cuando subí al escenario, el público guardaba silencio y podía resolver las instrucciones de la obra.
items.english: When I went on stage, the audience was silent and I could work through the play's instructions.

sections.content: Choose the indefinido when the listener can locate the experience as one completed episode, even if its effect lasts. Atreverse, presenciar, presenciamos, ocasión y presenciaba are useful forms to notice in this topic.

sections.topic: the preterite for completed past events
